verdict.rationale: SigNoz has no documented native AI incident or alert summaries. Instead, it offers an official MCP server and Agent Skills. These let external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) query metrics, logs, traces and alerts in natural language, and the documented use cases include investigating what changed after a deploy and tuning a noisy alert. Responders could get AI summaries this way, but only by bringing their own agent. Missing for 10: native in-product AI-generated incident/alert summaries, summary content attached to alert notifications for responders, detailed docs or hands-on evidence of summarization output, independent corroboration.
